label: 03 — AI-first delivery
heading: AI-assisted engineering,
sub: AI tools are part of how we deliver, not a service we sell. They shorten the path to working, tested and documented software; every result is still reviewed by an engineer and signed off by you.

principles.title: AI-assisted implementation and exploration
principles.desc: AI tools draft code, work through unfamiliar specifications and legacy sources, and try alternatives quickly, so working software arrives sooner and more time goes into your system's edge cases.

principles.title: Automated testing and documentation
principles.desc: Tests and documentation are produced with the code and kept current as it changes, including test cases derived directly from protocol specifications.

principles.title: Human review and your sign-off
principles.desc: An engineer reviews every change and is accountable for it. Nothing is delivered until you have signed it off.
